name: Bitly
whatYouLose: A short domain with years of reputation (yours may get flagged by spam filters at first)
Global edge redirects and uptime SLAs
QR code designer and campaign UI polish
prompt:
Build a link shortener with analytics, a Bitly replacement.

Stack: Cloudflare Workers + D1 (or Node + SQLite if not on Cloudflare).
Features:
- POST /api/links {url, slug?} with an API key header; random 6-char slugs if none given.
- GET /:slug → 302 redirect, logging timestamp, referrer host, country (from request headers) and device class. Never store raw IPs.
- Dashboard /admin (password env var): list links, click charts per day (inline SVG, no chart lib), top referrers and countries.
- QR code SVG for each link at /:slug.qr.
- UTM builder in the create form.
Done when: creating a link, clicking it 3 times and seeing 3 clicks in the dashboard works locally.
notes: A redirect plus a counter. Bring your own short domain and you are done in an afternoon.
